description: Example only. M0-T03 copies this to tests/check-plan.json and replaces every command with the real one once it exists. Scripts under scripts/product/ are created by the milestone that needs them. Live checks must write live-sessions.json (contracts/live-session.schema.json) into $HOH_EVIDENCE_DIR; the soak check also writes timeline.jsonl (contracts/soak-event.schema.json). Every check that is the scenario check of an AC writes test-results.jsonl (contracts/test-result.schema.json); independent checks write independent-report.json (tools/agent_task.py --report-out) and copy the reporting attempt's record and raw stream as native-attempt.json and raw-session.jsonl; traceability writes traceability-report.json (docs/adr/ADR-027.md); build writes hoh-release.tar.gz (CR-003).

build.description: cargo build --workspace --release --locked; npm ci && npm run build in web/ (from M6)

static.description: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -D warnings; tsc/eslint for web/

recovery.description: kill -9 / restart / lost-ACK fault matrix from docs/09-testing.md
